rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a concrete veto-memorandum template. Both documents begin with the identical formula “I AM withholding approval of H.R. …,” identify and quote the bill, explain its operation, develop objections based on governing principles and harmful consequences, and distinguish the proposal from an acceptable legislative alternative. The other candidates share only narrower subject matter or general argumentative functions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I AM withholding approval of H.R. 7854 "To confer jurisdiction on the Court of Claims..."
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I AM withholding approval of H.R. 6818, a bill "To amend title X of the Social Security Act..."
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive identical opening formula followed by the bill number and quoted title.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The bill confers jurisdiction upon the Court of Claims... The measure also provides that the court shall determine...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Title X of the Social Security Act provides... H.R. 6818, now before me, would permit the States...
shared_material.explanation: Both next describe the existing legal framework and the precise operative change made by the bill.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The enactment of legislation in derogation of these firmly established principles would, in my opinion, create a most undesirable precedent. Moreover, such provisions would discriminate against all other claimants.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The most compelling reason for disapproval of this bill is my firm belief that the unsound principle on which it is based would seriously hinder further progress...
shared_material.explanation: Each grounds disapproval in a broader governing principle and argues that breaching it would create systemic harm beyond the immediate beneficiaries.

shared_material.child_excerpt: While I would not object to a measure which would merely permit Sedgwick County to secure a judicial determination... I cannot approve a measure which would permit recovery of penalties and interest...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: What is needed in the public assistance area is... A bill such as H.R. 6818... is in no sense a response to my recommendation and offers no real solution...
shared_material.explanation: Both contrast the rejected bill with a narrower or more appropriate legislative course the President could support.
